**What problem would this solve?**
A clear description of the problem or gap.

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like to see happen.

**Alternatives considered**
Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Privacy note**
If this involves camera data, storage, or network calls, please note how it fits the
project's local-only, no-frames-ever-stored privacy stance (see SECURITY.md).
